SELECT T1."XCL_035" || ' ' || T1."XCL_036" AS full_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3."XCL_009" = T4."XCL_010"
WHERE T2."XCL_018" LIKE '%food%'
  AND SUBSTRING(T4."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'
  AND T2."XCL_020" < (SELECT AVG(T5."XCL_020") FROM expense AS T5 WHERE T5."XCL_018" LIKE '%food%')

    m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name

JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_021 = 'Food'
  AND strftime('%m', ev.XCL_012) = '09'

  )
